pages.title: Void Scythe
pages.text: A two-handed scythe that carries the void's hunger into every swing. Its 360° sweep strikes all nearby enemies, and a charged strike releases a crescent wave that pierces creatures and passes through walls for five seconds.

pages.title: Void Erosion & Execution
pages.text: Sweeps apply Void Erosion, while every hit has a small chance to mark the target for Execution. When the mark expires, a giant scythe descends and the target is judged: ordinary foes are erased, elites and bosses lose a portion of their maximum health.

pages.title: On the Form
pages.text: The scythe's form is also being redone: it still uses the old mould, and the new one will be opened together with the Void armor plates. Its sweep, crescent and execution feel are unaffected.
